profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Finance and Tech industry.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building AI/LLM infrastructure and data platforms for Risk Equities.
- Architected and deployed a production MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enabling AI agents to securely query Risk Equities margin and workflow data via natural-language tools — async FastMCP/Starlette/Uvicorn stack with nginx-fronted proxy validation, per-user RBAC, and full audit-event logging; adopted by 6 business analysts across 2 teams.
- Cut manual SDLC toil by ~80% (from ~3 hrs to ~30 min per release) by building LLM-agent automation for Jira epic generation, release metadata, and migration planning, gated by human-in-the-loop review controls.
- Unblocked production SSH/SFTP compliance validation with a credential-backed connectivity test framework — REST/UI controls, batch fan-out jobs, controlled test-file delivery — reducing deployment risk for IP-restricted production changes.
- Led design of REST APIs and SQL data layers automating 100+ high-priority Risk Equities reports; drove design reviews and mentored 2 engineers.
Stack: Python, FastMCP, Starlette, Uvicorn, SQL, Java, LLM agents, RBAC, nginx

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built high-throughput Spark pipelines ingesting 500GB+/day of third-party market data into AWS S3, cutting data-retrieval time for the quant research team by 40%.
- Engineered an async pub/sub microservices backend (NATS + Protocol Buffers) streaming real-time market data to PostgreSQL and frontend interfaces at sub-50ms latency.
Stack: Python, C++, Spark, NATS, Protocol Buffers, PostgreSQL, AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built automated ETL pipelines powering Tableau reporting and predictive models; containerized services with Docker for consistent deployments.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Built a Django data pipeline and analytics dashboard (Dash, Plotly) for interactive metric analysis; work featured in company research articles.

positions.title: Data Science Immersive | Data Science Fellow
positions.description:
Engaged in a 15-week data science career accelerator focused on supervised classification, regression modeling, unsupervised clustering, visual and statistical analysis, SQL databases and big data distributed systems

-Created several machine learning models to predict whether the closing price of a stock will be higher or lower than the opening price of a stock based on news sentiment release by 12pm ET. The best model predicted 9% better than random. 

-Created a machine learning model with NLP and python to predict the category of an app from its description with 84% accuracy rate. Data was collected from the Google Play Store by a web scraper our team developed.

-Constructed a user to user music recommending system with python based on the user rating of an artist from the Radio FM dataset.

-Built a multiple regression model with Python to predict 311 calls of a given NYC zip code using data from NYC Data API and the U.S. Census Bureau API. 

-Developed a Flask app with Python, SQLAlchemy to query data from the database and display data analytics of drug related events during U.S. holidays, using the FDA Adverse Events API.
